skill.name: managing-branches
skill.description: Guides safe Git branch checks, branch creation, sync review, and conflict reporting for repository work.
skill.summary: Inspect branch state, create branches from a base, and report Git issues clearly.
skill.author: 1gy

security_audit.summary: Static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline command formatting, and harmless stderr redirection. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or hidden unsafe behavior was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Placeholder branch arguments need careful handling.
remediation.suggestion: State that branch names must be copied from Git refs or validated before use in shell commands.
Ask for user confirmation before creating a new branch when uncommitted work exists.

content.value_statement: Branch state can be unclear during active repository work. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused Git checks and branch creation steps.
actual_capabilities: Checks the current Git branch and short working tree status.
Fetches remote branch information before reporting sync status.
Counts commits ahead of the configured main branch.
Creates a new local branch from a selected remote base branch.
Reports branch conflicts, permission errors, and remote sync issues.
limitations: It depends on Git being installed and available in the repository.
It does not resolve complex merge conflicts without user guidance.
It needs a known main branch name for accurate ahead counts.
It can only work with remotes configured in the local repository.

use_cases.title: Review Branch State Before Coding
use_cases.description: Check the active branch, local changes, remote sync state, and commits ahead of main before starting work.

use_cases.title: Create Feature Branches Consistently
use_cases.description: Fetch a base branch and create a new local branch from the matching remote branch.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Branch Workflow Errors
use_cases.description: Identify existing branches, uncommitted changes, remote fetch issues, permission errors, and conflict status.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the managing-branches skill to check the current branch, local changes, remote sync status, and commits ahead of main.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Feature Branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the managing-branches skill to create a new feature branch from origin/main. Report any uncommitted changes before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Branch Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the managing-branches skill to investigate why branch creation failed. Check existing branches, remote sync, permissions, and local changes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Branch Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the managing-branches skill to produce a branch readiness report with current branch, changes, ahead count, remote state, and required user decisions.

output_examples.input: Check whether this repository is ready for new work.
output_examples.output: Current branch is feature/login. There are two modified files. Remote tracking is current. The branch is three commits ahead of main.

output_examples.input: Create a branch for the billing update from main.
output_examples.output: Created the requested branch from origin/main. No local changes were present. Remote branch information was fetched before creation.

output_examples.input: Why did my branch operation fail?
output_examples.output: The target branch already exists and local changes are present. Choose the existing branch, provide a new name, or commit the changes first.

best_practices: Run the branch check before creating or switching branches.
Confirm the intended base branch before creating new work branches.
Resolve or save local changes before branch operations that change state.
anti_patterns: Creating branches without checking for uncommitted local work.
Assuming the main branch name without checking project guidance.
Continuing through complex conflicts without asking the user.

faq.question: What does this skill inspect first?
faq.answer: It checks the current branch, local changes, remote branch state, and commits ahead of the main branch.

faq.question: Can it create a new branch?
faq.answer: Yes. It can fetch a base branch and create a local branch from the matching remote branch.

faq.question: Does it resolve merge conflicts?
faq.answer: It identifies conflict status and asks for guidance when resolution is complex.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: It may contact configured Git remotes when fetching branch information.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it safe for repositories with local changes?
faq.answer: It reports local changes first and recommends saving or committing work before risky branch operations.
